value.label: Value view
value.note: Answers read from the Value Graph.

questions.text: How much value have we delivered so far?

answer.text: For ACME’s accounts payable clerks, invoices now reach the right approver first time more often: first-time-right routing rose from 62% to 81% after Approver suggestion was delivered. Business value is not yet known.
answer.basis: Investment: Invoice Automation team · 26 PI4 (640 hours) · Delivery: Approver suggestion, Exception triage agent · Value stream: 2 needs · Strategic: Customer satisfaction
answer.gaps: Exception resolution and customer satisfaction have no recorded figures. Unknown is never shown as zero.

questions.text: Where is value leaking for ACME?

answer.text: Clerks find the approver first time, but invoices still wait: approvers cannot approve on the go. Nothing delivered serves that need yet; Mobile approval is still in progress.
answer.basis: Value stream: Approve invoices on the go (gap) · User: Approver · Delivery: Mobile approval (in progress)
answer.gaps: Exception resolution has no outcome recorded, so leakage there cannot be judged yet.

questions.text: What did the hours invested produce?

answer.text: 1,280 hours went in. 640 hours delivered two changes, one with a measured outcome; 160 hours mapped the value stream and found an unserved need; 480 hours are in progress on Mobile approval.
answer.basis: Investment: 3 team planning increments · Delivery: 4 items
answer.gaps: Hours are not yet converted to cost, so return on investment is not shown.

portfolio.label: Portfolio view (skills)
portfolio.note: Same graph, with the Investment lens grouped by the skills used.

answer.text: Approver suggestion, the only change with a measured outcome, drew on 160 hours of Product discovery and 240 hours of AI agent design. Value stream mapping (160 hours) found the unserved need for mobile approval.
answer.basis: Investment by skill: 3 skills · Delivery: Approver suggestion, Value stream mapping workshop · Value stream: 2 needs
answer.gaps: The same 1,280 hours as the value view, grouped by skill. Grouping never changes a figure.

questions.text: Which skills have no measured result yet?

answer.text: Delivery coaching (360 hours) went into Mobile approval, still in progress. AI agent design also went into the Exception triage agent, which is delivered but has no outcome measured.
answer.basis: Investment by skill: Delivery coaching, AI agent design · Delivery: 2 items · Value stream: 2 needs
answer.gaps: Results will show once outcomes are recorded.

questions.text: Is every skill backed by real work?

answer.text: Yes. All four skills link to done, delivered or in-progress work. A skill with no linked work would show as claimed, not demonstrated.
answer.basis: Investment by skill: 4 skills · Delivery: 4 items
